title: 25 years — Generational capacity
reflection: A child today becomes an adult. Education, health, trauma, leadership, dignity, and opportunity shape a generation.
userPrompt: What will today’s children need in 25 years?
actionMeaning: Invest in capacities that protect learning, health, dignity, and leadership.

title: 100 years — Living memory and inheritance
reflection: The choices made today may become the stories, institutions, wounds, and possibilities inherited by future families.
userPrompt: What institutions would we want them to inherit?
actionMeaning: Build institutions and stories future generations can inherit with dignity.

title: 250 years — Civilizational humility
reflection: No one can forecast this horizon. It is a moral imagination exercise: what kind of human chain are we strengthening?
userPrompt: What would it mean to act as a good ancestor?
actionMeaning: Choose actions that protect life, dignity, learning, wellbeing, and peace capacity.
caveat: Reflective horizon, not prediction or policy forecast.
